sources.claim: Official design documents content-addressed repository storage, encrypted/authenticated blob and metadata formats, and snapshot content/metadata.
sources.application: Prefer a maintained encrypted engine with original whole-file SHA catalog, not hand-built encryption or one plain hash directory.

sources.claim: Default check is structural; check --read-data also reads actual stored packs.
sources.application: Require full data integrity read before independent restore; sampled structural checks do not fulfill this first-batch gate.

sources.claim: Restore can select a specific snapshot into an explicit target; path layout should be verified against the snapshot listing.
sources.application: Restore an exact snapshot into a fresh outside-checkout directory, then independently compare all original relative paths, whole-file hashes, sizes and metadata.

limits: Technical backup-engine research only; no legal retention duration, provider transfer authorization, cryptographic deployment approval or current installed engine acceptance inferred.
